Restore previous clipboard puts back what you had copied when the 8-second paste window ends, unless you copied something else meanwhile. Keep transcription leaves the transcription on the clipboard. If pasting fails, Murmur keeps the transcription on the clipboard for recovery.

meetingCallPrompt.description: When Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, Slack, FaceTime, Webex or Discord starts a call, ask whether to record it. The question stays until you answer it or the call ends. Murmur never records without a click. While a meeting records, also ask whether to stop it once the call ends. Murmur never stops it without a click.
